summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure by removing dead migration code, then resolve all PR review comments from CodeRabbit, and fix SDK E2E test failures caused by the now-removed vault crypto DB columns.
summary.outcome: Phase 20 fully completed with 9/9 verification truths passing and GAP-01 resolved. All 6 CodeRabbit PR review threads resolved (3 fixed, 3 not applicable). SDK E2E tests fixed to remove references to dropped crypto fields.

repo: Vault blob v2 format is now canonical — DB columns (encrypted_root_folder_key, encrypted_root_ipns_private_key, migrated_at) are fully dropped; server is zero-knowledge
InitVaultDto only accepts ownerPublicKey and rootIpnsName; NestJS validation pipe rejects extra properties with 'property should not exist'
VaultExportDto no longer contains encryptedRootFolderKey — any code asserting on that field needs updating
SDK E2E test harness (tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts) was still sending old crypto fields on vault init after the migration cleanup
Phase 20 had 4 original plans + 2 gap closure plans (20-05, 20-06) totaling 6 plans
recovery.html is a standalone IPFS-direct recovery tool with no bundler — plain JS with inline helpers
rootIpnsName format follows pattern ^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$ (alphanumeric, starts with k)

code.finding: Deserialization did not reject zero-length key_len — added validation to throw on key_len === 0
All fetch() calls lacked AbortController timeouts — added fetchWithTimeout helper with 15s/30s limits
rootIpnsName flowed into innerHTML unsanitized — added format validation and escapeHtml helper
Export-file path still tried to decrypt encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey unconditionally — made optional since v2 blob doesn't require it
encryptVaultKeys helper and its usage needed removal — vault init no longer accepts crypto fields
Assertions on encryptedRootFolderKey in vault export response needed removal after DTO simplification

workflow: GSD gap closure mode (--gaps-only) skips research and reads VERIFICATION.md directly to scope plans
Plan commits are made by the planner agent itself — orchestrator should check git log before attempting a duplicate commit
Pre-wave dependency check skips key-links that reference files in the upcoming wave (not prior waves)
CodeRabbit comments on already-executed plan files or deleted code paths can be marked not applicable with explanation
SDK E2E CI failures can be diagnosed by fetching job logs via gh CLI before the run fully completes

friction: Orchestrator attempted to commit plans that the planner agent had already committed (bd236c59a), requiring a git log check to detect
Verification file path resolution required multiple bash commands to locate due to working directory ambiguity between cipher-box and cipher-box-phase-20
vault-lifecycle.test.ts was accidentally overwritten with Write tool during editing, requiring a subsequent Edit to restore the last test case
CI failure for SDK E2E tests was not caught by local tests — the plan execution tests didn't cover the E2E harness fixture sending deprecated fields
open_items: 2 items flagged for human verification: new user v2 blob publish to IPFS before API registration, and recovery tool IPFS-direct path with real vault (require live environment)
Next phase is Phase 23 — discuss-phase 23 suggested as next step
encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey handling in recovery.html export-file path is now optional but the decrypt path still exists — could be removed entirely in a future cleanup
